continuity.question: Was hat sich seit gestern geändert?
continuity.answer: The strongest delta is execution placement: Anthropic-Akamai adds a large distributed CPU-cloud commitment, Google adds local and hybrid agent execution, and Microsoft quantifies robot-to-edge or cloud offload. Bilateral U.S.-China incident coordination also gained a named process while broader guardrail positions remained split.

Local-token split is a vendor demo, not an independent production distribution.
